notes: Fiscal year ended September 28, 2024 (matches data.js fy 'Sep 2024'). SOURCING CAVEAT: www.sec.gov refused the research user agent, so the FY2024 Form 10-K (accession 0000320193-24-000123) could not be read directly. Cash, stock-comp and segment figures are quoted from Apple's own FY24 Q4 condensed consolidated financial statements on apple.com (unaudited, released with Q4 results), and every cash and stock-comp value was confirmed against the SEC XBRL facts filed with the FY2024 10-K. The 2025 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001308179-25-000008, filed January 10, 2025) was read from a copy of the SEC courtesy PDF hosted by a third party (9to5mac.com), which is the `url`; the matching EDGAR document is in `edgarUrl`. The copy's PDF metadata shows creation on January 10, 2025, and the holder percentages reconcile with the stated share count (1,317,966,471 / 15,037,874,000 = 8.76%; 1,043,713,019 / 15,037,874,000 = 6.94%), but it should be confirmed against EDGAR. LEADER: Steve Jobs is deceased. The proxy discloses no holding by his estate, family or a related trust (no Jobs-related entity is a 5% holder), so family is null and no source is attached. HOLDERS: Vanguard and BlackRock percentages are stale; the proxy bases them on Schedule 13G/A filings reporting ownership at the end of December 2023, applied against the January 2, 2025 share count. Berkshire Hathaway is not listed as a 5% holder in this proxy. Dividends include dividend equivalents paid on RSUs, as the cash-flow line says.
